_comment: Per-million-token prices used to estimate eval cost. gpt-5.4-mini is the Stanford AI API Gateway education rate, derived from the gateway's usage report on 2026-11-02 (13,889 in + 1,103 out = $0.007690). Add other models before comparing them; unknown models report cost as null and the runner never guesses. Claude prices are Anthropic first-party list prices per million tokens as of 2026-11-03 (Haiku 5.5: prompts up to 100K tokens).
